--- COMPOSE-BODY ---
# Hermes core stack. Boring and stable on purpose.
# Start:   ..\start-hermes.ps1   (or: docker compose up -d)
# Status:  docker compose ps
# Logs:    docker compose logs -f <service>
# Stop:    docker compose down   (data persists)
#
# Storage note: C: is nearly full, so Ollama models (the big files) are bind-mounted
# to D:\HermesData\ollama. The small services use named volumes (fine on C:).

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    container_name: postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"   # host 5433 -> container 5432 (host 5432 is already in use)
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7
    container_name: redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data

  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Loopback-only publish: reachable on the host (127.0.0.1) for OMEN's SSH tunnel,
      # NOT exposed on the LAN. Container still listens 0.0.0.0 internally (OLLAMA_HOST unchanged).
      - "127.0.0.1:11434:11434"
    volumes:
      # Models live on D: to spare the nearly-full C: drive.
      - "D:/HermesData/ollama:/root/.ollama"
    # GPU passthrough via Docker Desktop WSL2 + NVIDIA driver on the host.
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
              capabilities: [gpu]

  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    container_name: open-webui
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    environment:
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: http://ollama:11434
    volumes:
      - webuidata:/app/backend/data
    depends_on:
      - ollama

  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    container_name: portainer
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - portainerdata:/data

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
  webuidata:
  portainerdata:
